title: Code and data for: Stable volume but falling age-specific rates of rheumatic valve surgery in Brazil's public health system, 2003–2025
description: Analysis code, analytical datasets and aggregated results reproducing every table and figure of the study of rheumatic valve surgery in Brazil's Unified Health System (SUS), 2003–2025, based on public, anonymized DATASUS data (SIH/SUS hospital admissions, SIM mortality) and IBGE population estimates. Hospital and admission identifiers in the analytical datasets are replaced by meaningless codes.
